channel.title: What2Eat Blog
channel.description: Meal ideas, meal planning and cooking guides from the What2Eat team.

item.title: What should I cook today? A simple way to decide in five minutes
item.description: Stuck on what to cook today? Use this 5-question method to pick a meal in minutes, with ideas for busy days, special days, leftovers and picky eaters.

item.title: The best ways to plan daily meals without a complicated system
item.description: Practical ways to plan daily meals: theme nights, a rotating menu, batch prep and simple templates. Pick the method that fits your household and stick with it.

item.title: What to cook with ingredients you already have
item.description: Turn what's in your fridge and pantry into a real meal with a simple base-plus-protein method, proven combinations and pantry-based recipe search.

item.title: Easy Pakistani dinner ideas for every night of the week
item.description: Easy Pakistani dinner ideas, from 30-minute daal and karahi to weekend pulao and nihari. Organised by time and occasion, with tips for faster desi cooking.

item.title: Quick breakfast ideas for busy mornings
item.description: Quick breakfast ideas for busy mornings: 5-minute, 10-minute and make-ahead options, from eggs and paratha to overnight oats, plus time-saving tips.

item.title: How to reduce food waste at home
item.description: Practical ways to reduce food waste at home: plan meals, shop smarter, store food properly, cook from what you have and use leftovers, with UNEP data.

item.title: How to plan meals for guests without the stress
item.description: Plan meals for guests without stress: how many dishes to make, quantities per person, a balanced dawat menu, make-ahead timing and a day-of cooking schedule.

item.title: Easy lunch ideas for every day
item.description: Easy lunch ideas for every day: homestyle desi lunches, packable office and school lunches, and quick 15-minute options, with tips to keep lunch varied all week.

item.title: How to decide what to eat every day
item.description: Tired of deciding what to eat every day? Learn why food decisions feel exhausting and use simple rules, rotations and tools to decide faster with less stress.

item.title: How meal planning makes cooking easier
item.description: How meal planning makes cooking easier: fewer daily decisions, smarter shopping, less waste, faster weeknights and more variety, plus how to start.
